title: fix(app-shell): Studio list-view filter offers a picklist field's options and stores the option value
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「Interfaces → 列表视图 → Filter」里，选项（picklist）字段的过滤值从自由文本框改为该字段的选项下拉，存的是选项的 value（`new`），不是标签（`New Request`）。
- 为什么改：作者照着看到的标签输入，视图存了一个谁都匹配不上的值，草稿还显示有效，运行时列表却显示「没有符合此视图过滤条件的记录」。
- 风险与回滚：只给字段目录多带一个可选的 `options` 键，复用运行时列表已在用的同一个 FilterBuilder，没有新编辑器；其它字段类型不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ObjectListViewInspector.picklistFilterOptions-27515.test.tsx`（钉住的行为）、`useObjectFields.ts`（读出 options）、`widgets.tsx` 的 `FilterBuilderField`（把 options 交给 FilterBuilder）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.picklistFilterOptions-27515.test.tsx`，预期 3 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27515

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The Studio list-view inspector already mounts the runtime list filter's `FilterBuilder` (through the designer's `filter-builder` widget). That builder draws a picklist column's value as a picker over the column's `options` and stores the option `value`, but only when the column it is handed carries `options`. The Studio field catalog dropped them at three layers, so a picklist column fell through to the plain text input:

1. `useObjectFields` (`ObjectFieldInfo`) now reads the served field's declared `options` in the spec's `SelectOption` shape, `{ value, label }`, and only that shape.
2. `ObjectListViewInspector` passes them on in its `fieldCatalog` (`ObjectFieldOption` gains an optional `options`).
3. `FilterBuilderField` (the `filter-builder` widget) hands them to `FilterBuilder` with the column.

No second picklist editor and no new export: the value control is the runtime one, per the triage note. Other field types are unchanged (a number field keeps its input; the control test pins it). Stored shape is unchanged: the spec's `ViewFilterRule[]`, now with the option value.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.picklistFilterOptions-27515.test.tsx`, through the REAL `useObjectListViewDraft`, the REAL panel and the REAL `useObjectFields` over a REAL `MetadataClient` (only the Radix popover is rendered inline, as `widgets.filterBuilderHeldRow-26738.test.tsx` does):

- a stored picklist rule (`status equals new`) shows a picker reading `New Request`, and no free-text value box;
- Add filter on the picklist, pick `New Request`: the buffered view's filter is `[{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'new' }]`;
- CONTROL: a number rule keeps its plain value input.

## Acceptance notes

- **Collapsed inspector summary.** The filter trigger's summary is built from the rules' field labels only (`summary` in `FilterBuilderField`); it has no place for the operator or the value, so it still reads `Status`. Not changed here; adding operator and option label to it is a new piece of copy for the seat to card if wanted.
- **Runtime half (ui seat 2's area, not fixed here).** In `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `ListView`, the toolbar Filter popover's `FilterBuilder` is drawn from `currentFilters`, the user's session conditions seeded from the `initialFilters` prop; the view's own declared `filter` is applied as the base query and is never drawn among those rows, so an end user can neither see nor clear it there. Read from source, not measured in a browser.
- **Sibling host with the same strip.** `ViewVariantInspector` (metadata-admin; also mounted by the runtime `ViewConfigPanel` through `objectFieldsOverride`) builds its `filter-builder` catalog as name, label and type only, so a picklist column there still gets the text box. Same defect class, outside this card's file surface; listed for the seat.
- **Option labels are the author's, untranslated.** The runtime list translates option labels through its i18n resolver; Studio shows the declared label, as the rest of the Studio inspector does.
- **Dispatch-order conflict, named:** the order asks for the runtime half "with file:line"; `ui/AGENTS.md` commandment 11 (cite by content) bans line addresses in issue and PR bodies, so it is cited by symbol above.
- The harness's after-PR assignee/review step is skipped on purpose (maintainer rule: a human sees the PR only after the seat's review).
